hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.swift) command -v swiftformat >/dev/null && [ -f "$f" ] && swiftformat --quiet "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *'git commit'*) cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; if [ -x scripts/check-secrets.sh ]; then scripts/check-secrets.sh >&2 || exit 2; fi ;; esac; exit 0
